_provenance.supersedes: The MS1-MS6 set of fieldwise-run-01 (MS1 M6, MS2 M12, MS3 M16, MS4 M20, MS5 M23, MS6 M30). The Pack carries five milestones whose last falls at M30, so the placement window is milestoned by construction and no seeded MS6 is needed; the prior D5.4 double-claim sequencing question dissolves with the deliverable set that carried it.
_provenance.scope_note: criterion_statement is the Pack's milestone line, verbatim in substance. Turning each statement into a verifiable achievement criterion with a responsible party is Phase 4's output (CLAUDE.md §7 Phase 4), not this seed's.

milestones.criterion_statement: Historical knowledge base and target definition complete.
Model and scale-transition framework ready for final prospective assessment.
MVP ready for industrial placement evaluation.

milestones.note: MS5 at M30 milestones the placement's completion directly, resolving by construction the monitoring concern that produced the seeded MS6 of the prior structure: the operational assessment (D5.1) and the exploitation roadmap (D5.2) are the deliverables that evidence it.

steering_decision_points.source_ref: Operator ruling of 2026-08-28 (decision_log/fieldwise-run-02-baseline_2026-08-28.json), re-anchoring the item-4 governance pattern to the Pack's milestone months
steering_decision_points.note: The Steering Group's corrective decision points track the milestones (go/no-go verdicts on MS1-MS5), plus the retained mid-placement review at M27. Re-derivation of the operator's 2026-08-12 pattern, ratified 2026-08-28: the prior calendar (M6/12/16/20/27) tracked the superseded milestone months; the verdicts belong at the milestone months, and the M27 mid-placement point survives on its original reasoning (an evaluated placement must not run unmonitored between M24 and M30... the M27 point reviews the placement mid-window; MS5 at M30 closes it).

points.purpose: Mid-placement review of the M25-M30 non-academic placement at AgroVIR (aligned with the monthly face-to-face technical review of T5.3).
points.source_ref: Operator decision of 2026-08-12, retained by the 2026-08-28 ruling
points.note: Carries no milestone: MS5 at M30 verifies placement completion; M27 is governance, not verification.

steering_decision_points.consequence: The Steering Group meets five times: M6, M14, M18, M24, M27. The Career Development Plan is reviewed at the same five points (the plan-review-alongside-steering-points pattern of item 6 / AR-10, re-anchored). K11's target reads the same five points.

placement_verification.statement: The verification of the M25-M30 placement period is carried by MS5 at M30 and its deliverables D5.1 (operational/interoperability assessment) and D5.2 (post-MSCA FMIS integration and exploitation roadmap).
placement_verification.note: Structural in the Pack: the milestone falls at the placement's last month. The prior structure's seeded-MS6 workaround and its D5.4 double-claim Unresolved question are retired with the structure that needed them.
